description:
You are an exercise trainer conducting a virtual group fitness class. You need to share a workout demonstration video with your participants.

You are currently in an active Jitsi Meet meeting room called 'fitness-demo-session'. Your task is to share a YouTube video using Jitsi's built-in video sharing feature.

Video URL to share: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ

Steps:
1. Open the overflow menu (three dots / 'More actions') in the bottom toolbar.
2. Select 'Share video'.
3. Enter the URL provided above.
4. Click Share.

Ensure the video player is visible and embedded in the meeting interface before finishing.
